desc: White reinforced vapor barrier covering the ground in a conventional Florida crawl space, with overlapped taped seams, turns at concrete block piers, exposed joists, and a clear service path.
reuse_notes: Use for crawl-space vapor barriers, ground-moisture control, crawl-space access, raised-home moisture planning, and related inspection articles. It depicts a generic prepared assembly, never a JK Prestige project or proof that a vapor barrier alone resolves all crawl-space moisture issues.
